clips.title: The story
paras: Grelin Whitebeard keeps a field journal in Coldridge Valley. The dwarf scout records Frostmane troll activity in its pages, until Grik'nir the Cold steals it and drags it into the troll cave.

Grelin Whitebeard watches the Frostmane trolls near Coldridge Valley and records their movements in a leatherbound notebook. His field notes describe their strength, organization, and threat. Grik'nir the Cold, a heavily marked troll brute, takes the journal during a confrontation or ambush and carries it into the troll cave. Grelin needs the notes to finish his report, so he asks passing adventurers to retrieve the book.
